platform: WSL Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64; official Godot 4.8.beta2.official.cafc17a19; headless GDScript reference
head_difference: Release checkout includes a subsequent tools/debug/test_debugctl.py-only change; no application files differ between commits.
scope: Bounded source review, strict profile and Home admission of the existing Stik/Club fixed-wing companion profile. Solver parity has a separate nine-tape receipt and is not exact replay or physical validation.

review.analysis: Main adds a lens stack consuming accepted player contact and presentation data, and background accident-report valuation. Companion setup and transition functions are unchanged. AppRoot adds staged Home loading, selection/preview of RC vehicles and refuses fixed-wing Fly while a non-aircraft activity is selected. The ordinary Home fixed-wing companion configuration handoff remains; normal and rejected routes are exercised by the strict shell and companion suites. This is not full semantic closure of dependencies.

snapshot.description: Linux candidate imported and tested; release checkout compared before promotion. All sixteen manifest sources and the versioned project and D11g guards matched after LF normalization. No tracked solver change after recorded solver rebind. The engine, AppRoot, Main and project byte hashes were unchanged across the checked suite. These are point-in-time checks and do not lock the files.

home_shell_test.derivation: Removed exactly one accept_current_solver_for_tests call from a disposable copy, following the previous behavior receipt; real Home, Fly, Main and Manager paths and assertions are unchanged.
